pair_decision: Both final patches passed the frozen host-owned semantic checks, fresh offline wheel build/install, full project suite, and the required independent reviews. baseline_calibration.note: The frozen baseline semantic run passes legacy single-channel, empty-list fallback, and primary response destination. It fails only the additional input-channel behavior and invalid-list configuration rejection checks. Task, prompt and grader are frozen before either condition.

first_pass_outcomes.v1: The first security review found raw invalid-channel text echoed by ConfigError; fixed and retested before final reviews. A transient validation-order regression during the fix was restored before the final passing run.
first_pass_outcomes.v2: An independent code review found blank entries in nonempty channel lists were accepted; fixed with regression coverage before final acceptance and reviews.

protocol_limitations: One Orca TUI process was reused, but `/new` was observed before v2 and again between v2 and v1, and the candidate was reset to the same baseline; exact Codex thread/turn IDs remain unavailable.
